candidate_commit: FILL-IN: the 40-character commit id of the candidate tested
spec_revision: FILL-IN: the specification revision in spec.lock
started_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when the test or drill started
completed_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when it finished

data.batch_size: FILL-IN: a whole number: Number of USB sticks in the batch
data.kit_sha256: FILL-IN: 64 lowercase hex: SHA-256 of the kit image written to the batch (64 hex)

checks.media_id: FILL-IN: text: Label on this stick
checks.sha256: FILL-IN: 64 lowercase hex: SHA-256 the verifier printed for this stick
checks.hardware: FILL-IN: one of low, mid, high: Hardware class of the laptop used
checks.offline_install: FILL-IN: true or false: Did it install with networking off?
checks.hash_verified: FILL-IN: true or false: Did the verifier report the hash as verified?
checks.operator: FILL-IN: text: Who did the check (name or role)
checks.at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time of the check
checks.evidence_sha256: FILL-IN: the SHA-256 of this raw proof file, which is also listed in the index: the photo or verifier output

data.device: FILL-IN: Device or environment used: hardware class, model and asset label, OS version (or the staging environment name)
